title: Deep-sea mineral exploration contracts issued (count)

source.name: Status of exploration contracts for polymetallic nodules, sulphides and crusts
source.publisher: International Seabed Authority (ISA), a UN body

notes: The ISA began issuing 15-year exploration contracts in 2001 to the original pioneer investors (around 8 initial contracts). Counts grew to 16 by mid-2014, 29 by late 2020, 30 by January 2025, and 31 by January 2026 -- across polymetallic nodules, seafloor sulphides, and cobalt-rich crusts, mostly in the Pacific's Clarion-Clipperton Zone.
